from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re

def scrapeReddit():
    # define the subreddit to scrape
    subreddit = "PersonalData"

    # create a list to store the personal data found
    personal_data = []

    # use the requests library to make a GET request to the Reddit API
    response = requests.get("https://www.reddit.com/r/" + subreddit + "/.json")

    # use BeautifulSoup to parse the HTML of the response
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")

    # find all the links on the page that contain personal data
    links = soup.find_all("a", href=True)

    # loop through each link and extract the personal data
    for link in links:
        # check if the link contains personal data
        if re.search(r"Personal Data|Location|Date|Time", link["href"]):
            # extract the personal data from the link
            personal_data.append(link["href"])

    # return the list of personal data found
    return personal_data

# call the function to scrape the subreddit
